## Description

AP242 file uses the AP203/AP214-style `datum_reference` to attach datums directly to a tolerance, when it should use a `datum_system` containing `datum_reference_compartment`s.

## Reproducer recipe

`geometric_tolerance` with `datum_reference` chain (legacy) inside an AP242 file.

## Expected kernel behavior

Warn; map to equivalent `datum_system` form on import.
